Overview
The second issue of volume 40 for 2026 includes:
- Evidence-to-Decision Framework to Prioritize PD-1 and PD-L1 Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors for the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines to Treat Adults with Solid Tumors in the Palliative First-Line Setting: Pilot Study
Consultation Documents
- Bioequivalence For Immediate Release Oral Dosage Forms
- Model quality assurance system for procurement agencies
- Points to consider on integration of environmental sustainability strategies and metrics into pharmaceutical manufacturing
Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical/Defined Daily Dose (ATC/DDD) Classification
- ATC/DDD Classification (Temporary)
- ATC/DDD Classification (Final)
Volume 40, No. 2, concludes with the International Nonproprietary Names (INN) List -
